SQL:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    (
      orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND orders.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.revenue",
    SUM("orders.revenue") OVER (ORDER BY "orders.order_date") AS "orders.running_total"
  FROM base
), shifted__time_shift_inner AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), sjoin__time_shift_inner AS (
  SELECT
    step1."orders.order_date",
    step1."orders.revenue",
    step1."orders.running_total",
    shifted__time_shift_inner."orders.revenue" AS "orders._time_shift_inner"
  FROM step1
  LEFT JOIN shifted__time_shift_inner
    ON step1."orders.order_date" - INTERVAL 1 MONTH IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted__time_shift_inner."orders.order_date"
), step2 AS (
  SELECT
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.revenue",
    "orders.running_total",
    "orders._time_shift_inner",
    "orders.revenue" - "orders._time_shift_inner" AS "orders.mom_change"
  FROM sjoin__time_shift_inner
)
SELECT
  "orders.order_date",
  "orders.revenue",
  "orders.running_total",
  "orders.mom_change"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.revenue",
    "orders.running_total",
    "orders._time_shift_inner",
    "orders.mom_change"
  FROM step2
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "orders.order_date" ASC
LIMIT 21
